The billing position settles the cause. There is exactly one goods receipt (GR-2026-0048) for the full ordered quantities, and it was already fully invoiced by ledger invoice 00833/KPI/2026 for the identical total of 6566316. Adding this invoice brings invoiced to 13132632 against value received of 6566316, so invoicing is **not** `within_received`.

That rules out `separate_delivery` (there is no later delivery — only one receipt exists) and points to `resubmission`.
